title: Mouseover a day should show the day's events
line: Hovering a day in the clock's calendar now shows a tooltip listing that day's events.
explanation: The calendar's day cells only had a tooltip for the alternate-calendar label, so hovering a day with events showed nothing and the agenda only followed the clicked day; to see another day's events you had to click it. Holidays didn't get a tooltip either, because the holidays plugin only sets the short label under the number. The day's tooltip now lists the titles of that day's events (one per line, after the alternate-calendar label if any), fetching them only while the day is hovered.

commits.message:
components/calendar: list the day's events in its tooltip

Hovering a day in the calendar only showed a tooltip for its holiday
label, so seeing what was on another day meant clicking it. The day's
tooltip now lists the titles of all its events, one per line.

BUG: 433669

media.caption: Hovering November 17 (a moon phase event): nothing shows, the agenda stays on today.
December 24 selected, hovering December 25 (two holidays): no tooltip.
Hovering December 25 lists both holidays; the agenda still shows the selected December 24.

reviews.text: Displaying a day's event titles in its tooltip on hover is a much better UX choice than switching the left-side agenda on hover, and fetching events lazily on hover avoids unnecessary model calls. However, returning an empty string from toolTipText as soon as hovered becomes false clears PlasmaComponents.ToolTip.text while the tooltip's exit fade transition is still playing, causing the tooltip to collapse to a tiny empty box while fading out.
changes: Avoid clearing PlasmaComponents.ToolTip.text immediately on unhover: keep the last computed text (updating it when showToolTip becomes true, or when eventCount/subLabel/thisDate change while hovered) and bind PlasmaComponents.ToolTip.visible to dayStyle.showToolTip && dayStyle.toolTipText.length > 0 so the tooltip fades out cleanly with its text intact.

reviews.text: Hovering a day now shows its event titles in the day cell's existing tooltip, which fulfils the title ("Mouseover a day should show the day's events"); using a tooltip instead of the KDE 4 agenda-follows-pointer behaviour is a sound, well-argued choice, since the agenda sits beside the grid and would jump around as the pointer crosses other days. The code is small and lazy (eventsForDate is only called while hovered and only in Days view), dedupes the alternate-calendar sub-label, and reusing eventsForDate's single-entry cache is safe because the agenda recomputes when it asks for a different date. Screenshots show single and multi-event tooltips with the agenda staying on the selected day, and the commit message matches the diff. Nitpick: the tooltip doesn't refresh if an event title changes while hovering without the event count changing, which is negligible.
